translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

content: Kora medacfora yeni mitiyegec yofi heigec.
KEBU ye engena, ye oyang boyang memibesonga. Yeac tiki kpetiacfu, Anutuninaac amatoau, ye dengerebesonga.
Tiki imoc herea nga gombunga yombong amma bangectoa bangec sogac sogai meficgeyemmeude. Imoc Siong tiki, imoc not bigeng yombong tacde amma imoc ngictau Engenatoa, yeac taong.
Anutungo ngictau amatoau tacma amea onggonggema gombunga henggareng ammiude, imoc hengkecdimbe.
Negenggec, ngictau yeneng kpedzucnema yenahafoc dzikac kpegecdeac hama
taongtoa imoc hemma kpidohoma kengec homac yombong yunuu woragec.
Yeni hemma kengecyunuu dzonongngina fedeec. Ngacngo ngadze kiu kpendzeng kpeande, yeni ifi isoc kpendzeng kpegec.
Geng wenac ere ereaunac firang dena imocngo hama Tarsisi taonggac wage kpedzameyunuande, ge ifi isoc memanganeyununa yeni kengectoa anggec.

Neni warac siduha negening, imocac fora hening. Nga kicninango KEBU kurumenggac wasaiareng kunengngina Anutuninaac taonnu hening. Anutungo amatoa imoc tatahau faiu nasoya nasoya seria feengkefude. Selac
O Anutu, geng yoac dedzege amma imoc modackecnec, imoc geac womonnu namma negensiandimbe.
O Anutu, geac kpac kuneng nga geac eriendzong imoc bangec tegia fekendaemoc kpesereyunuu negendacgecde. Ge marifoigango firang angkecnecac mariga imocngo wakede.
Siong tiki ye ubangerec negembeso nga ge wiac foraya deannecac Yudaac amafora yeni sogaibisia.
Ngeni Siong yerecgema yeac odaac ama herec herec osoma kpetengina mebisia.
Ngeni Siong tikiac oda dafia, imoc mengere hemma ngictauac amaseria hembisia. Hemma fingecsahenina fekefude, imocac siduc yofi meyemmebisia.
Anutu yomoc nenang Anutu, ye nasoya kpac kecengkefude. Yeng sing edzacnunukefungoc kekecnina wisickeude.
